description: Exact lookup in the official Godot 4.7 class reference, offline: `Class`, `Class.member`, `Class.Enum.VALUE`, `@annotation` or a global function. A class gives its parents, properties with defaults, methods, signals and enums; a member gives its exact signature and description, found through inheritance. Use it before calling any engine API you are not sure about; when you do not know the exact name, use godot_api_search first. `detail` brief gives the signature and the first paragraph; full gives the whole entry. An unknown name returns an error with close matches, and a Godot 3 name with its Godot 4 name. It changes no project files; when learning is on, it counts the lookup in Godotwright's local learning file so later misses get better hints (GODOTWRIGHT_LEARN=0 turns that off).

detail.description: brief: short output with capped lists; full: everything (default for this cheap profile: brief).

name: godot_api
title: Look up the Godot 4.7 API
